body: In this world of ※4⛬, it's not like in the anime where you can embark on a journey gloriously at ten years old, receiving a ※4⛬ to roam the world.
This is a genuine real world, and the rules are very strict.

To receive a ※4⛬ and travel, you must be at least fifteen years old; at most, you can be one year early, fourteen years old, to own your own ※13⛬, but you are not allowed to travel, and the Alliance keeps a very close eye on this.
Why? Because even a ※4⛬ with a dozen levels of strength is a considerable threat to ordinary humans.
If it falls into the hands of an immature child, who knows what trouble they might cause, with unimaginable consequences.
However, there are always exceptions.
Children from prominent families have privileges from a young age, with their families arranging for ※4⛬ to accompany them as they grow up.

Although they aren't officially captured at first, the child and the ※13⛬ live together day and night, and when they grow up and complete the procedures, they are already far ahead of others when they set out.
This is also a key reason for the strong family influence within the Alliance; ordinary commoners are at a vast disadvantage compared to them, an unbridgeable gap.
※11⛬ was only fourteen when he graduated from school and left the orphanage.
Although he had saved some money, this meager saving was not enough to cover his own living expenses and also raise a ※4⛬.
In his helplessness, he could only temporarily abandon this idea.
Actually, ※11⛬ wasn't without ideas; he had considered that if he made and sold basic ※3⛬s and basic ※12⛬, he would surely make a quick fortune.
Unfortunately, he lacked the relevant certificates, so the items he made couldn't enter Alliance stores at all.
The ※0⛬? He didn't even dare to think about it; he didn't even have a single ※13⛬, so rushing in would be like a lamb entering a tiger's den, seeking his own demise.
Just like that, half a year passed.
During these six months, thanks to ※11⛬'s system, working at the breeding center and pharmacy became increasingly smooth, and his savings gradually grew to fifty or sixty thousand.
※11⛬ calculated in his mind and had an idea: he planned to use this money to buy a ※4⛬, and he was quite confident that he could find a good deal and acquire one with good potential.

Why? Because as the system collected more and more information, its scanning function also became stronger and stronger; now, for common ※4⛬, the system could scan and clearly display their strength, potential, and detailed training and breeding methods.
But the system also had its shortcomings; limited by previous data, it could currently only provide breeding methods up to the ※7⛬ stage.
For ※7⛬-level and above, it was completely in the dark, knowing very little.
Although he could slowly explore, that speed was like a snail crawling, far too slow.
※11⛬ knew this, but there was nothing he could do; most of the knowledge in the school library was basic, and breeding methods only went up to Superior-level at most.

Anything beyond that, like ※7⛬-level knowledge, was only available within prestigious universities, old ※14⛬s, and major families, or could be exchanged for large amounts of resources from the Alliance, and it was rarely shared externally.
After all, in the eyes of a ※10⛬, training methods are their most prized possessions.
In the ※0⛬, ordinary ※7⛬-level training insights could sell for at least a million, and ※5⛬ ones were astronomical, starting at tens of millions, and almost impossible to find.
Any ※5⛬ ※10⛬ who was doing reasonably well wouldn't be foolish enough to reveal their trump card and sell it to others; that would just be asking for trouble.
※11⛬ looked at the fifty thousand yuan in his hand, his brows furrowed into a knot, filled with worry. He muttered to himself:
“I can't just buy one with ordinary potential, can I? What future would it have then? Its prospects would be bleak.”
Perhaps fate was kind to him, or perhaps it was purely good luck.
One day, on his way home from work, ※11⛬ saw a ※8⛬ lying unconscious on the ground.
At first, he didn't pay much attention; he had seen this situation many times.
He was about to walk away; in this day and age, who could guarantee that a fainted ※4⛬ wouldn't go mad and attack people once it woke up? Such things had happened before.
But just then, ※11⛬ had a sudden impulse, and as if by some strange twist of fate, he used the system to scan the ※8⛬.
With that scan, his eyes widened instantly, and he almost jumped up in excitement; the system showed that this ※8⛬'s potential was Superior-level!

It's important to know that an ordinary ※8⛬ sells for only thirty to fifty thousand in a breeding center, while a Superior-level one would cost at least two hundred thousand; at that price, the money in ※11⛬'s pocket wasn't even enough for a fraction.
※11⛬ stared longingly at the ※8⛬, practically drooling with desire.
Finally, gritting his teeth, he took it home, fed it, and meticulously cared for it, eventually waking the ※8⛬.
When ※8⛬ woke up, seeing ※11⛬'s devoted care, it felt grateful and also wanted a stable home; the two hit it off, and ※8⛬ became ※11⛬'s first ※4⛬.
After getting ※8⛬, ※11⛬ worked for a while longer.
But slowly, he realized that if he kept working like this, when would he ever become a true ※10⛬? It was not a long-term solution at all.
So, he stomped his foot, quit his job, and went home to focus solely on training ※8⛬, planning to train for a while before venturing into the outskirts of ※2⛬.
In this world, prices for general daily necessities are quite affordable; food and such are not expensive, enough for ordinary people to live on.
However, anything related to ※13⛬ immediately skyrockets in price.
Only ※9⛬s are considered a benefit provided by the Alliance to ordinary people; a common ※9⛬ costs only one or two hundred, which is very cheap.
But beneficial berries and medicinal herbs for ※13⛬, any single type, can cost hundreds to thousands, ridiculously expensive.
Why did ※11⛬ want to take risks?
He had done the math; relying on his meager income from working, it was difficult to even feed ※8⛬.
Although ※8⛬ ate ※3⛬s made by ※11⛬ himself and carefully prepared ※13⛬ food, which didn't require extra money to buy, the raw material costs were not low.
※8⛬'s daily food expenses plus the nutrition needed for training would cost three to five hundred, and ※11⛬ only earned over ten thousand a month from his work.
Just eating would make him poor.
If he didn't take risks, he and ※8⛬ would eventually starve.
Of course, if ※8⛬ were only raised as a regular pet, the cost would be ten times less, thirty to fifty a day would be enough, eating the same food as humans.
But in that case, ※8⛬'s strength would basically stagnate, and even if there was some improvement, it would be extremely slow; this ※13⛬ would essentially be useless.

PS: ※4⛬ potential and strength levels are divided into: Ordinary, Superior, ※7⛬, ※1⛬, ※5⛬, ※6⛬, and ※6⛬. Ordinary strength is only below Level 30, Superior is 31-50, ※7⛬ is 51-60, ※1⛬ is 61-70, ※5⛬ is 71-80, ※6⛬ is 81-90, and ※6⛬ is 91-100.
